exportOperations: Evaluate MULTIRES at level1 on each realistic body using CPU mesh operations
Keep body geometry above one horizontal plane: female sourceZ1.395m, male sourceZ1.435m
Recenter X at midpoint of own two source eye bounding centers, preserve other source coordinates
Retain each source eye as a separate named mesh with its original geometry
Smooth polygon normals, retain source UVMap, omit materials, scripts, armatures, animations, lights and cameras
Export +Y-up/+Z-front GLB; source anatomy is unchanged. Runtime uniformly fits the whole head and eyes, constructs the neck transition to BODY84, and applies a small neutral upper-eyelid expression.
runtimeNeck: The source lower-neck region tapers continuously to the actual BODY84 cross-section, then joins its exact positions, weights and normals. Jaw, mouth and eye globes retain their source shape.
